claimed_value: matryoshka NLA captures most FVE within the first few bullet lines (marginal FVE decays roughly exponentially, negligible past line 3); outperforms standard NLA on suffix prediction under short (<16 token) truncations, roughly matches it for longer truncations
notes: setup_box.sh pulls six Qwen2.5-7B NLA checkpoints (~90 GB) with the author's token and the sweep loads 7B AV+AR models (author: 48 GB card). On a 24 GB card with 86 GB free disk and ~6 MB/s downloads this is out of scope; no measurement attempted. Entrypoint string in the catalogue was a chain description; VRAM estimate (15 GB) undercounted by the base-model size.
